title: WELCOME & PLAYER READINESS
subtitle: Learn AgWorld, then prepare for the field with Compliance.

missions.title: Welcome to AgWorld
missions.objective: Discover your menus, missions and map with your System Administrator.

missions.title: Check Your Player Information
missions.objective: Save your name, role, contact number and working region.

missions.title: Submit Required Documents
missions.objective: Upload your required Company documents privately for submission.

missions.title: Complete Mandatory Safety Training
missions.objective: Complete the Company safety and responsible field conduct assessment.

missions.title: Create Your Profile Photograph
missions.objective: Take a webcam photograph or upload a profile picture.

title: KNOW YOUR PRODUCTS
subtitle: Build a sourced product pitch with the Product Commander.

missions.title: Meet Your Product Range
missions.objective: Study an approved model presentation and explain its application.

missions.title: Match the Product to the Farm
missions.objective: Use model specifications to explain a benefit and a limitation for a client.

missions.title: Build a Confident Product Pitch
missions.objective: Compare two models using approved sources and ask your Product Commander a question.

title: SCOUT, CONNECT & GROW
subtitle: Build real relationships and expand Company territory with Sales.

missions.title: Your Sales Territory Briefing
missions.objective: Choose an existing prospect or begin scouting your area.

missions.title: Scout Your Working Area
missions.objective: Select a province or municipality and inspect its recorded market.

missions.title: Inspect a Farm Prospect
missions.objective: Select a real farm on the map and review its business information.

missions.title: Record Your Farm Intelligence
missions.objective: Create a farm if it is missing, or save updated intelligence on an existing farm.

missions.title: Classify Your Prospect
missions.objective: Record whether the selected farm is neutral, competitor-aligned or a Company client.

missions.title: Scout a Contractor
missions.objective: Create or update a real contractor record through Map Menu Actions.

missions.title: Scout a Competitor
missions.objective: Create or update a real competitor record through Map Menu Actions.

missions.title: Plan a Drone Meeting
missions.objective: Choose a neutral or competitor prospect and record a real meeting plan.

missions.title: Record the Client Outcome
missions.objective: Record what happened at the meeting and the agreed next step.
